relationships: Anna (friend) — reciprocal attachment and non-sexual intimacy
Ryuji (romantic interest) — epistolary attraction and distance
Monte Iwaki (mountain) — perceived spiritual teacher and non-human mentor
Kissaten Miyazaki (space) — identity origin and paternal sanctuary
Kairi.psychological_arc: autonomy emerging through loss and changing relationships

Atsuo.narrative_function: provides care, protection, and a model of paternal presence

Anna.role: best friend, mirror-self, central relational anchor
Anna.hāfu_identity: hāfu character with Italian-Japanese family background
Anna.narrative_function: friendship provides recognition, belonging, and a shared experience of difference

Yuki.narrative_function: provides an alternative form of maternal care and creative transmission
Yuki.cultural_bridge: transmits origami practice and embodied knowledge

Reira.role: absent parental figure, catalyst for family rupture
Reira.narrative_treatment: presented as a complex adult whose choices have consequences without reducing her to a single moral category
Reira.consequence: her disappearance contributes to Kairi's increasing self-reliance
Reira.ontological_status: absent, unresolved, and largely inaccessible to Kairi

Ryuji.narrative_significance: embodied adolescent attraction mediated by distance
Ryuji.connection_mode: primarily letters rather than sustained direct interaction
Ryuji.key_moment: brief hand contact in ocean water

Hirosaki.ontological_weight: primary setting with strong character-like narrative presence

Monte Iwaki.ontological_weight: perceived spiritual teacher and non-human mentor
Monte Iwaki.narrative_function: models perspective, permanence, and wisdom through silence

Kissaten Miyazaki.narrative_function: embodies Atsuo's practices of hospitality, attention, and care

Ajigasawa.ontological_weight: escape-space, romantic threshold, family-linked coastal space
Ajigasawa.narrative_function: displacement creates conditions for adolescent emotional and romantic change

Repetition (Cento volte).semantic_scope: recurring events and environments return with altered emotional meaning

Silence.semantic_scope: non-speech as communication, processing space, environmental condition, and resistance
Silence.narrative_function: directs attention toward omission, gesture, and what remains unspoken

Chosen Family.semantic_scope: affiliative bonds that supplement or replace disrupted family structures
Chosen Family.narrative_function: explores how care and belonging can emerge through relationships of affinity

Autonomy.semantic_scope: self-governance emerging through changing family circumstances
Autonomy.growth_arc: from dependence toward increasing participation in household and personal decisions

Hybridity.semantic_scope: intersections among cultures, languages, foodways, and aesthetic systems
instances: apple pie as a recurring cultural object
Hybridity.cultural_significance: difference is represented as a lived condition rather than a simple deficit
